d.title: Kaette Kita Court no Naka no Tenshi-tachi
d.jp: 帰ってきたコートの中の天使達
d.synopsis: Akira Motoura and his team or rather his harem travels to a hot spring resort to train for the upcoming volleyball game. This time they got two new rookies to strengthen their effort. Little they know that they being lured in a trap set by the two beautiful newcomers.
